ANVIL STUDIO

Three steps to better gear

  1. Choose your gear

    Pick your edition, version and item. Start with unenchanted gear.

  2. Pick your enchantments

    Each choice is one enchanted book, already at that level. Use Recommended for a starting selection.

  3. Follow your anvil steps

    Click Show my steps. Keep the left and right slots as shown, then tick off each step. The graph shows how they connect.

Each Survival step must cost 39 levels or less.

Combining books

Choose Book to combine your selected enchanted books into one. No blank book is needed. With just one enchantment selected, your book is already ready.

Already used your item or books?

Open More options and set their prior-work counts. Use 0 for untouched items. After a combine, the new count is the higher input count plus 1.

The cost includes both inputs’ work penalties, plus the enchantments on the right. A work count of n gives a penalty of 2ⁿ − 1.

Levels or XP?

Fewest total levels adds up the level costs shown by the anvil.

Least XP assumes you earn exactly enough levels for each step, starting from level 0 every time. Your cost differs if you spend from a higher level.

Making a Wind Burst book

Wind Burst drops at level I. Combine two level-I books for level II. For level III, make two level-II books and combine them: four level-I books in total.

Make it first. The plan includes its prior-work penalty, but excludes the levels spent preparing it.

Limits and older versions

The planner handles up to 13 different books. It does not upgrade duplicate lower-level books, repair durability, rename gear or import existing enchantments.

Edition and version control the available enchantments and conflicts. Historical protection stacking and the Mending/Infinity exceptions are applied automatically. The 1.11.1 exception requires Infinity on the left.

Allowing other incompatible enchantments produces a theoretical plan that needs commands or mods.
